title: Tehran - Septemer 20, Alaeddin Boroujerdi, a member of the Iranian Parliament's National Security Commission, made remarks in an inrweview
text:
Tehran - Septemer 20, Alaeddin Boroujerdi, a member of the Iranian Parliament's National Security Commission, made remarks in an inrweview"

"Source: IRNA"

"==============="

"SOT1, Alaeddin Boroujerdi, Member of Iranian Parliament, (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:54): "In my opinion, their [the U.S] losses and damages are in the billions, and the outcome of this action, in addition to our control over the Strait of Hormuz, which is our right, must be the absence of the United States from the region. If they want to rebuild the American bases, after a few years they might feel the urge to attack once again. We must definitely create conditions [to avoide it] ,this is a requirement of our national security, so that the United States no longer possesses this capacity. We have also announced to the countries of the region that our policy toward you is one of good neighborliness, friendship, and mutual interests, but we will certainly not allow attacks to be launched against us from your soil, and we will certainly act decisively in this regard. Therefore, in my opinion, the time has come for the United States to migrate out of the region.""

""
"SOT2, Alaeddin Boroujerdi, Member of Iranian Parliament, (Farsi)-(00:55 - 01:50): "[IAEA] Their legal duty, which is written in the statutes and explicitly stated in the NPT treaty, is to support member countries that are committed to not developing nuclear weapons while simultaneously pursuing peaceful nuclear activities; they should even transfer technology to them, which they do not do. In contrast, the director [Grossi] remains silent in the face of illegal attacks by countries such as the United States and the Zionist regime. The head of our atomic organization {eslami] wants to attend an official summit [in Vienna] but cannot. What is the point of our presence in NPT anymore? In my opinion, the time has come for us to say goodbye and state that there is no place for the Islamic Republic of Iran to continue its presence in an organization that cannot protect the interests of its members.
